Messages.Author: SirTemple
Messages.Body:
This came up today, and I wanted an official responce.

The Setting:

I'm at 7 pool with Camille Devereux and Gitane St. Claire in torpor. Badger
was just influenced out last turn. Camille has one blood and Tasha Morgan,
Gitane has 0 blood, a fame, the Soul Gem of Etrius, and J.S.Simmons.

My predator has just finished bleeding me with Rebekka, Chantry Elder of
Munich, who has a pulse of the Canille(superior). He ends his turn, by briging
out Spiridonas.

It is the begining of my turn.

I untap both minions in torpor
Gitane attempts to play Rapid Healing to leave torpor, Rebekka Wakes with
Evenings Freshness and plays Enhanced Senses to block.

Rapid Healing says combat doesn't occur, therefore I can not play Form of the
Mist, correct?

Assuming so, Gitean is desblorized, which activates the Soul Gem.

I think the vampire comes into play immediately, and doesn't have to wait
untill the influence phase. Is this also correct?

Assuming so, the vampire drawn for the Soul Gem is Camile (another copy).
Being younger she comes into play and contests the Camille already there.

If this is the case, the camille in torpor can't take any actions this turn,
since she and her retainer have eft play. My question is when can I get one of
the Camilles back. On my next untap, I will forgo one camille, do I have to
pay for the one I keep? Does the one I keep come into play immediately, or not
for another full turn?

Thanks,
Jason

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <19980228215...@ladder02.news.aol.com>,
SirTemple <sirt...@aol.com> wrote:

>This came up today, and I wanted an official responce.

Well, I'm not official, but I'm sure LSJ (blessings upon him and peace) will
duly chastise me if I stray from orthodoxy.

>The Setting:
>I'm at 7 pool with Camille Devereux and Gitane St. Claire in torpor. Badger
>was just influenced out last turn. Camille has one blood and Tasha Morgan,
>Gitane has 0 blood, a fame, the Soul Gem of Etrius, and J.S.Simmons.
>My predator has just finished bleeding me with Rebekka, Chantry Elder of
>Munich, who has a pulse of the Canille(superior). He ends his turn, by briging
>out Spiridonas.
>It is the begining of my turn.
>I untap both minions in torpor
>Gitane attempts to play Rapid Healing to leave torpor, Rebekka Wakes with
>Evenings Freshness and plays Enhanced Senses to block.
>Rapid Healing says combat doesn't occur, therefore I can not play Form of the
>Mist, correct?

Correct; Rebekka's controller has the option to diablerize instead.

>Assuming so, Gitean is desblorized, which activates the Soul Gem.
>I think the vampire comes into play immediately, and doesn't have to wait
>untill the influence phase. Is this also correct?

Correct.

>Assuming so, the vampire drawn for the Soul Gem is Camile (another copy).
>Being younger she comes into play and contests the Camille already there.
>If this is the case, the camille in torpor can't take any actions this turn,
>since she and her retainer have eft play. My question is when can I get one of
>the Camilles back. On my next untap, I will forgo one camille, do I have to
>pay for the one I keep? Does the one I keep come into play immediately, or not
>for another full turn?

From the Sabbat-updated rules, at
<http://members.aol.com/bbretall/jyhad/rules/rules_2_7.htm>

A. UNTAP PHASE (6.1) [12.1]

[these bytes sacrificed to Shub-Internet, Black Router of the 'net with a
thousand ports! Ia!]

2. If you have a contested card which all other Methuselahs have yielded,
it becomes uncontested (controlled) and is untapped. (15)
3. Take the following steps in any order. (6.1) [12.1]

[Ia!]

b. Contest or Yield your contested cards and titles. (16) [12.1]
i. Pay one pool for each unique card that you are Contesting. (16) [8]

[Ia!]

iii. Burn any card that you are yielding, along with any other cards
or blood on that yielded card. (15) [8]

So you don't get to yield Camille (A) until your next untap phase, and
you don't get Camille (B) back until the untap phase after that.

gomi

--
kono sora wo daite kagayaku,
shounen yo shinwa ni nare.

No. When the bearer of the Soul Gem is diablerized, the Gem is burned
with no other effect (VTES card text). This text seems to be in error
(if anyone recalls my lengthy explanation on VTES-L), but there it is.

I'm seeing if the RT cares to issue errata to fix it (making work as
it did in the Jyhad printing). But that takes time.

it did in Jyhad. Note that this is not official:

>

> <http://members.aol.com/bbretall/jyhad/rules/rules_2_7.htm>
>
> A. UNTAP PHASE (6.1) [12.1]
>

> 2. If you have a contested card which all other Methuselahs have yielded,
> it becomes uncontested (controlled) and is untapped. (15)
> 3. Take the following steps in any order. (6.1) [12.1]
>

> b. Contest or Yield your contested cards and titles. (16) [12.1]
> i. Pay one pool for each unique card that you are Contesting. (16) [8]
>

> iii. Burn any card that you are yielding, along with any other cards
> or blood on that yielded card. (15) [8]
>
> So you don't get to yield Camille (A) until your next untap phase, and
> you don't get Camille (B) back until the untap phase after that.

Correct, assuming that you pay 1 pool to contest Camille B in the
same untap that you yield Camille A.

--
